    # opposite (top/left) boundary, leaving its original cells untouched.
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg}:
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):

                for c in range(w):
                    pr,pc=r-dr,c-dc
                    if 0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w and grid[pr][pc]==color:

                    while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==bg:
                        out[rr][cc]=color; rr-=dr; cc-=dc
    return out
